description: Summarize durable project context for future engineering work. Use when asked to document architecture, conventions, constraints, or handoff state.

# Project context

Derive context from current source, docs, tests, and deployment—not memory alone.
Record architecture, commands, conventions, important constraints, known
limitations, and unresolved work. Keep secrets, credentials, private tokens, and
machine-specific sensitive data out. Update an existing handoff/context file
when suitable; create a new artifact only when requested.
